name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie back on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Start with the dumbbells over your chest, palms forward.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest.
Press them back up until your arms are straight.
cue: Lower to the chest, press up and in
mistakes: Letting the dumbbells drift out to the sides.
Arching the lower back off the bench.
